name: HOLO✦PAD
problem: Traditional screens constrain how people interact with digital objects. Exploring 3D experiences often requires specialized hardware or complicated software.
bet: Browser-based graphics, computer vision, and AI could make spatial experiences more accessible without requiring a dedicated headset.
whatBuilt: A browser-based platform concept exploring the conversion of 2D images into 3D experiences, using web graphics, AI-assisted vision pipelines, and interactive spatial interfaces.
